title: Passing Yards V237 V187 Fallthrough Fix
root_cause: Public NFL -> Passing Yards reaches current V237 but the delegated route detection misses the same-run session state, falls through the historical router chain, and V187 raises RuntimeError('Router V187 direct handler is player-prop identity only.') before any Passing Yards hub renders.
patch: V237 reads the live Streamlit sport/market session keys first. For Passing Yards only, it temporarily redirects V187 PROP_HUBS['Passing Yards'] to nfl_passing_yards_hub_v85 while preserving V235's Passing hub override. A process lock and finally block restore both globals after rendering. V187, V236, V85, app.py, and sitewide Monster owners remain unchanged.
acceptance: Focused tests prove live session-state Passing Yards detection.
Focused tests prove V187/V235 handoffs point to V85 only inside the Passing Yards render and restore on success and exception.
Branch real UI NFL -> Passing Yards exposes V85 and no V187 RuntimeError.
DevSystem final gate passes before merge.
Public production proof after merge must show no V187 RuntimeError and the cleaned V74 panel at 390/768/1440 before GREEN/FROZEN.
